filters:

  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
  docx: default
---

In HTML, a wrapped figure whose caption goes to the margin keeps its normal
layout, with a warning. It wraps in PDF through LaTeX, PDF through Typst, and
Word.

## The cap-location cell option

```{r}
#| label: fig-cap-cell
#| fig-cap: "A cell figure with cap-location."
#| cap-location: margin
#| classes: wrap-right
#| out-width: !expr if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) "5in"
plot(1:10)
```

The paragraph after the cell with cap-location. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.
